source: export.monster.Monster31.initBBDC()+setAction() in 打开我开始玩.swf; sheet 4.swf chid5 Monster31. 邪.唐僧 (Evil Tang Seng), 3rd link in level-4's sequential boss chain (32->33->31->34). Single unbranched constructor (no gc.curStage form-select like level2's monsters) with isBoss=true baked in unconditionally. Row4 is a shared multi-purpose pose bank (jump1 col0/jump3 col1/hit8 col2/hit9 col3/hurt col4 all start at different columns within the same row; only hurt is encoded here, 1 frame). No dedicated dead row: death is a plain TweenMax alpha-fade to 0 in setAction('dead'), not a bitmap row — omitted (documented, not invented). Recovered stats in data/levels/level4.ts.
